sentences.span: The FOMC raised the funds rate by 25bp to 3.75-4% today... there were no dissenting votes against today's hike.
sentences.why: 25bp to 3.75-4.00% and no dissents both confirmed; 'first hike since 2023' independently confirmed in 16682__db-early-morning-reid-macro-strategy.txt ('The Fed delivered its first hike since 2023 last night').

sentences.span: a 16-2 majority projected at least one more hike this year, with four participants projecting two more hikes this year... no dissenting votes
sentences.why: 16-of-18 (16-2), four projecting two hikes, no dissents all match. Goldman's pre-meeting expectation of a Waller dissent confirmed in 16593__september-fomc-preview-a-hike-without-a-signal.txt ('We expect Governor Waller to dissent').

sentences.span: other FOMC participants "widely shared" the view he had previously expressed that broad financial conditions are not restrictive
sentences.why: The 'removed a dose of accommodation' quote is real, but 'hard-pressed to describe current policy as restrictive' does not appear anywhere in the sources. The source instead says Warsh's previously-expressed view on financial conditions was 'widely shared' by others -- a different claim, recast here as a direct statement by Warsh about current policy.

sentences.span: our probability-weighted Fed forecast remains less hawkish than market pricing
sentences.why: Market pricing moved to reflect the hawkish dots more than Goldman's own forecast did -- the market treated the projections as the literal signal rather than discounting them, i.e. took them at face value.

sentences.span: the median neutral rate dot rose from 3.06% to 3.25%
sentences.why: 3.25% is real but is the FOMC's own median neutral-rate (interest rate) dot, not something 'both' parties are 'looking at' alongside an unemployment forecast. No source in the set mentions a 4.1% unemployment forecast or a 'natural rate' unemployment comparison tied to this meeting -- that content is invented and grafted onto a real figure.

sentences.span: Market pricing of the probability of further hikes this year rose 8pp to 51% for October and 9pp to 78% for December today
Today saw ~70% of NYSE volume in declining stocks.
to see sentiment become less complacent, more oversold conditions, and a higher-correlation index decline for us to think this correction has run its course
sentences.why: Faithful paraphrase; 'stocks fall together rather than one at a time' correctly translates 'higher-correlation index decline'.

sentences.span: the S&P 500's Software Index rallied 3.2%, whereas the Semiconductor Index fell 4.4%
CEO Amodei's comments triggered the largest one-day move in the +Software / -Semis pair (JPPQSFSM Index) in its history, +12%
sentences.why: Exact match, JPMorgan. Amodei's call for slower AI development independently confirmed in pilot-data/pilot/source-text-all/2026-09-17/16678__pace.txt ('we must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models').

sentences.why: Exact match on magnitude, level, and causal framing (oil-driven inflation fears firming hike pricing).

sentences.why: Correctly attributed to the GS-labeled block; 'concentrated dealer positioning in GLD options' is a fair paraphrase of 'GLD gamma could amplify the move'.
